laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'rondom hom' is the more natural and clearer way to say 'the people around him'; bare 'om hom' reads stiffly.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'kwaad vir almal om hom' is ordinary, natural Afrikaans; 'rondom hom' is a lateral swap of one natural word for another.

laat_vaar.blok: Wat jy met 'n groot gevoel kan doen
laat_vaar.voor: sê vir jouself jy is kwaad
laat_vaar.na: sê vir jouself dat jy kwaad is
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Indirect speech reads more correctly and clearly at Grade 5 with 'dat' and the verb at the end.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Dropping 'dat' with main-clause order ('sê vir jouself jy is kwaad') is standard Afrikaans and plainer for a Grade 5 reader; the proposal only reads differently.

na_skrywer.na: Om te verstaan en saam te voel deur jou
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: The bare verbs make a fragment; the 'Om te ...' form is grammatical and matches the deernis definition.
na_skrywer.fout: The bare-verb definition is clipped and does not match the 'Om ... te' form of the neighbouring deernis definition.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The point is fair, but this is a glossary definition shared word for word across lessons, so the rewording must come through the writer for every lesson at once.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

na_skrywer.voor: vir iemand wat swaarkry te voel
na_skrywer.na: vir iemand wat swaarkry, te voel
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: A comma after the embedded relative clause makes the sentence easier to parse and matches the lesson's own style ('waarop jy gehoop het, nie gebeur nie').
na_skrywer.fout: Without a comma, 'wat swaarkry te voel' runs the verbs of two clauses together, which makes a reader stumble slightly.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The AWS comma at the end of the embedded clause would help, but it changes a shared glossary definition and is not a plain spelling or grammar error, so it goes to the writer.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.teks: Sê dit juis dan vir 'n grootmens wat jy vertrou.
vlae.rede: 'dit' has no clear antecedent in this block (the fire? the friend's grief? that the friend is struggling?); fixing it means choosing what the learner must tell, which is content, so it is flagged rather than changed.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Hartseer wys nie by almal op dieselfde manier nie.
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Hartseer lyk nie by almal dieselfde nie.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: Intransitive 'wys' here follows English 'shows'; 'lyk nie by almal dieselfde nie' is more natural and shorter.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'lyk' narrows the sense to appearance, while the paragraph describes behaviour (crying, going quiet, getting angry), and the original reads naturally.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Wat jy met 'n groot gevoel kan doen
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The disappointment is their own; the possessive reads more naturally than the definite article.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: Afrikaans naturally uses the definite article where English uses a possessive, so 'die teleurstelling' already reads well and the swap is lateral.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Hy kan wel bly waar sy maat is.
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Hy kan wel by sy maat bly.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'bly waar sy maat is' is wooden; 'by sy maat bly' is the natural phrase, keeps the meaning and matches 'Bly by jou maat' later in the lesson.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'by sy maat bly' can also mean staying over at or living with the friend, while 'bly waar sy maat is' says only that he stays present, so the preposition change moves the meaning.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Dit kan die grootmens by die huis wees
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Dit kan 'n grootmens by die huis wees
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The three options are parallel ('n onderwyser, 'n verpleegster), so the indefinite article fits; 'die grootmens' suggests one specific person.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'die grootmens by die huis' naturally means the child's own caregiver and reads well; changing it alters who to tell in a safety instruction for the sake of parallelism only.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The intended meaning is that the feeling makes you want to push back ('laat wil'); 'wil laat' says the feeling wants to make you.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'dit wil jou laat terugstoot' is idiomatic Afrikaans ('wil' meaning 'tends to'), so this is no grammar error, and the definition is shared wording.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'seermaak' needs an object here, as in the study text ('wanneer iets jou seermaak').
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: Intransitive 'iets maak seer' is standard Afrikaans, so this glossary definition has no grammar fault to fix.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Voel vir hom en wil help
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'nie noodwendig' is the natural Afrikaans for 'does not necessarily mean'; 'nie vanself' reads oddly here.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Nie vanself nie' (not automatically) is natural Afrikaans and plainer for Grade 5, so swapping in 'noodwendig' is a lateral move that shifts the nuance slightly.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'vra' has no object here, so it is unclear what is asked; 'gaan na die volgende een' keeps the meaning of turning to the next adult.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Gaan vra die volgende een' is natural, clear Afrikaans in context, and 'gaan na' changes a safety instruction from asking an adult to merely going to one.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: niemand van hulle doen dit verkeerd nie
laat_vaar_vorige.na: nie een van hulle doen dit verkeerd nie
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: With a counted group ('al drie'), 'nie een van hulle' is the more natural Afrikaans than 'niemand van hulle'.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'niemand van hulle' is natural Afrikaans here, so the swap is a lateral move.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Voel vir hom en wil help
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'deel' reads incomplete without saying with whom; 'met hom' matches 'langs hom' earlier in the sentence.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'jou kospakkie deel' is complete in context, and 'met hom' adds a third 'hom' to a sentence that already has two.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: soos brood deel en saam huis toe loop
laat_vaar_vorige.na: soos om brood te deel en saam huis toe te loop
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: After 'dinge soos' the activities read better as infinitive phrases with 'om ... te' than as bare verb strings.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: Bare verb phrases after 'soos' are natural Afrikaans, and the 'om ... te' form only makes the sentence longer.
